configuration.markdown.language.descript: UI language of the Markdown editor (toolbar, tooltips, panels). `auto` follows the VS Code display language. Changing this reloads open Markdown editors to apply.
configuration.markdown.hotkeys.descripti: Customize editor action hotkeys in the Markdown WYSIWYG/IR editor. Keys are action ids: `undo`, `redo`, `headings`, `bold`, `italic`, `strike`, `link`, `ordered-list`, `check`, `quote`, `line`, `code`, `inline-code`, `table`. Values are VS Code style combos like `ctrl+shift+z` / `cmd+b` / `ctrl+alt+1`; set `""` to disable an action's default hotkey. On macOS the `headings` action has no default hotkey (to avoid the system Hide conflict).
